Evidence / VIS-POS-TRANSACTIONS
Evidence record
When was it measured or observed?Mar-2025–Jan-2026 monthly

Reported POS transactions, monthly

01What does this evidence establish?

POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) rose from 8,015 in March 2025 to 24,026 in January 2026, within CBY-Aden's reporting scope, but not steadily: the monthly high was 27,187 in July 2025. Between December 2025 (21,099) and January 2026 (24,026), the raw totals imply growth of 13.87%, while the January source graphic displays +4.9%; the chart plots the reported totals, the +4.9% is given in the chart note, and the mismatch is recorded as a discrepancy within the source. Transactions are events, not unique users or merchants, so the series does not measure how many people or businesses used POS services.

Another view of the evidence
01What does this evidence establish?02What does it measure?03Who or what does it apply to?04How current is it?05What this evidence does not establish06Original source and verification07Method and verification detail

02What does it measure?

The monthly number of POS transactions reported by the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) within its reporting scope, March 2025 to January 2026.

03Who or what does it apply to?

POS transactions within the payment-system reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden); how far that scope covers each area of Yemen is not established.

04How current is it?

The latest observation in this record refers to January 2026; the series runs monthly from March 2025. January 2026 was the latest monthly POS release on the payments page of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) when checked on 26 September 2026. The figures should not be read as describing a later period unless a newer comparable release is published.

05What this evidence does not establish

Transactions are events, not unique users or merchants, so the series does not show how many people or businesses used POS services. The monthly values are shown as published, without smoothing or interpolation, and the +4.9% displayed in the January 2026 release and the 13.87% change derived from the raw totals are not arithmetically consistent. The totals fall within the reporting scope of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden) and are not shown to cover all of Yemen.

Limits of the measure

From July 2025 the monthly releases take the form of a one-page infographic; continuity of the reporting scope across that change has not been verified.

07Method and verification detail

Detail for reproducing or challenging this record without changing what it means.

How was it produced?

Monthly transaction totals as published in the monthly POS releases of the Central Bank of Yemen – Aden (CBY-Aden), without smoothing or filling. The December 2025 to January 2026 change of 13.87% is derived by this resource (24,026 divided by 21,099, minus one) and is kept beside the +4.9% displayed in the January release.

When does this record change?

This record is updated when an authoritative source is revised or replaced, a newer comparable observation becomes available, the definition, population or method changes, or the conditions for public use change.

How can I verify it?

This record is drawn from the source(s) listed on this page. Open a source record to reach the original document, and check that the definition, period, population and geography match what is stated here.

How should this record be read?

Read this evidence within the definition, population or group covered, calculation base where relevant, period, geography and method shown on the page. Before reusing or comparing it, check the source, limitations, evidence date and correction history. If a value or source link is unavailable, the page says so rather than filling the gap by inference. This resource does not host source files; where an original-source link is given, check the publisher’s terms before republishing.
